summary: CCH Holdings Ltd, a Malaysian restaurant operator listed with the SEC as a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its extraordinary general meeting held November 3, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. local time at its Bukit Mertajam, Pulau Pinang headquarters. Holders of 10,476,812.37 ordinary shares carrying 271,737,812.37 votes participated against 20,515,727 shares outstanding, constituting a quorum as of the October 15, 2026 record date. All resolutions presented were duly passed; full resolution text appeared in the October 26, 2026 notice of meeting filed on Form 6-K and is posted on the company website. No special-situation event or transaction terms disclosed.
